mapper.insert: insert into USERS (u_id, u_login_id, u_password, u_nickname, u_email) VALUES (USERS_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{uLoginId}, #{uPassword}, #{uNickname}, #{uEmail})
mapper.select: select count * from USERS where u_login_id = #{value}

select b_id, b_title, b_author, b_genre, b_description, b_quote, b_image, case when exists ( select 1 from book_chapter where book_chapter.b_id = book.b_id ) then 1 else 0 END as hasChapter
FROM book Where hook.b_title like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' order by book.b_id
select bc_id, b_id, bc_number, bc_title, bc_description FROM book_chapter WHERE b_id = #{bId} ORDER BY bc_number
